lines.text: Mercury. Dayside hits about 430 degrees Celsius; nightside falls to minus 180. Almost no atmosphere to hold the heat.
The terminator is sweeping across the surface. Stay in the crater shadows, and keep ahead of the sunlight.
Your heat meter is climbing. Get into a shadow crater before you cook.
Solar Panel Array recovered. Two down, one to go.
The shadows are your only safe places. The sun waits for no one.
Move steadily - panic burns fuel and time.
That glowing rectangle ahead is the outpost. The panel is inside.
